notes: Every sample contains 1% spike-in cells of E. coli BL21(DE3) pQrr2 (same species, other strain); mixed_organism left out. Valine addition = isoleucine starvation (amino_acid_starvation). Rifampicin samples were taken 10-45 min after rifampicin, which was added after 80 min of starvation: treatment abx_transcription;amino_acid_starvation, exposure from rifampicin time; the 45 min rifampicin sample (125 min after the shift) gets no growth phase.
